name: V4L5 — Listening Test 5
rules: Press Start the recording when you are ready. It runs about 26 minutes and plays straight through once, as in the exam — it cannot be paused, skipped or sped up.
The page turns to each new section as the recording reaches it. You can still tap a section tab to look back at its questions.
Read the instructions above each group of questions carefully — the word limit changes.
Answer all 40 questions, then tap Submit Test for your band score.
A 40-minute timer runs in the background; the test submits itself at zero.
Your answers save automatically on this device if the page reloads.
